from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper: its title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="Title of the current paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the document summaries) that this paper references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
